name: Moonwater Glow
description: Raise a glow that shimmers like moonlit water and shows what moves beneath its surface.

name: Draw Wave
description: Draw a small wave toward the user and pull a foe's stance with it.

name: Rippling Guard
description: Spread a guard of ripples that breaks a blow into small harmless waves.

name: Tide Draw
description: Draw a heavy tide through a foe's limbs so each step comes slowly.

name: Drawn Surf
description: Throw a wave of moon-drawn water that shoves all foes in close range.

name: Washing Phase
description: Wash a taint from an ally's body with a clean tide that turns with the moon.

name: Silver Wave
description: Raise a great silver wave that sweeps across the field and carries foes with it.

name: Undertow Hold
description: Drag a foe down into a pull beneath the surface and hold it there.

name: Moon Flood
description: Flood the whole field with moon-drawn water that weighs on every foe.

name: Tidal Moon
description: streams: Moon + Water; draw the moon down into the water stream so a tide forms that nothing on the field can stand against.

name: Hour Glow
description: Raise a glow that shows how long a thing has lain where it is.

name: Turn Mark
description: Mark a foe's coming move and turn its timing a beat out of step.

name: Slow Phase
description: Slow the phase of a foe's gestures so each takes longer than it should.

name: Cycle Guard
description: Hold a guard that repeats itself in a ring so each blow meets it fresh.

name: Quicken Phase
description: Quicken an ally's phase so the ally acts a little ahead of its foe.

name: Backward Hour
description: Wind a taint back through the hours until the ally is as before it.

name: Stretching Hour
description: Stretch the hour round a foe so each of its motions lasts long.

name: Phase Count
description: Count the phases left in a rising technique to know when it peaks.

name: Hour Surge
description: Send a surge that ages every foe's gear by a season in one stroke.

name: Held Hour
description: Hold a strong foe fixed in a single hour while the rest of the field moves on.

name: Cycle Seizure
description: Seize a powerful foe at the lowest phase of its strength and keep it there.

name: Turning Moon
description: streams: Moon + Time; turn the moon through the time stream so a foe's change is driven forward or held back at the user's word.
